sources.snippet: UK AI Job Hunter Dataset Dataset Summary This dataset is a curated collection of IT and AI job listings across the United Kingdom, designed for semantic deduplication and high-match candidate identification. It serves as a gold-standard dataset for training local LLMs to categorize jobs and predict match probability based on professional CVs.
